description: This file defines the TargetMetrics interface, which provides access to various metrics related to a Target object, including address metrics, JSON serialization methods, and constants defining JSON fields. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto project and includes nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: TargetMetrics
classes.description: An interface representing metrics about a single Target, including methods to retrieve address metrics and convert the object to JSON format.

classes.name: TargetMetrics.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested static class defining JSON field constants used in the serialization of TargetMetrics objects.

methods.name: getAddressMetrics
methods.description: Returns a map of address metrics keyed by address string.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the TargetMetrics object to a JsonObject, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the TargetMetrics object to a JsonObject based on specified schema version and field selector.
